requirements.statement: Keep a physical logistics site distinct from an organization and its legal designation.
Distinguish documented origin,destination and storage functions without inferring an unreported function.
Retain a generic documented physical-site link when the specific function is unknown.
Do not infer an occurred logistics event from registration,authorization or a plan alone.
Do not impose global exactly-one sites,total participation or disjoint site functions without supporting semantics.
Keep source-qualified candidate statements separate from verified world facts.
